description: The court also made it clear that the release of payments would be subject to further orders passed in the matter.
body_lead: The Kerala government has been permitted by the state high court to release the second instalment of over ₹11 crore to state-run electronics company Keltron for installing and operating artificial intelligence (AI) cameras aimed at detecting traffic violations and reducing road accidents. A bench of Chief Justice AJ Desai and Justice VG Arun allowed the state to release the second instalment as the first tranche of ₹11 crore had already been paid, the cameras were installed and were working, and challans were being issued.
